strategies:
name: Two app replicas
description: Scale the Spring app out behind the load balancer; each replica brings its own 10-connection pool to the same database.
changes:
  - service: app
    replicas: 2

description: Double the app's CPU limit (2 → 4 cores).
changes:
  - service: app
    cpu: 4
